request: Open a new terminal beside New conversation in the project context.
scope: Existing hosted prototype only. No production code, frozen handoff source or product snapshots changed.
changes: Adjacent New conversation and New terminal buttons in the project sidebar, including the mobile drawer.
New terminal in each pane and a terminal split action in the pane menu.
Typed terminal session metadata: project, workspace, root path, shell and unique session ID. Existing chats receive the single example project's metadata.
Distinct terminal icon, PowerShell surface, working directory and honest demo label. Chat model, skin and approval controls do not apply to terminal tabs.
Terminal input, output, command history, caret and scroll participate in stable iframe moves and fixture-state window transfer.
Focus enters a newly created session after its frame is ready; mobile project drawer closes after creation.
Narrow chat skill control now has an explicit accessible name.

validation.coverage: 8 existing R7 tests including 150 viewport/layout/state combinations; 3 added terminal tests covering creation, project ownership, mixed tab/layout persistence, draft restoration, command history, drag, real popup split/return, mobile drawer and local pane menu.
validation.accessibility: Zero axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA violations in tested dark/light mixed panes and 320, 390, 800px terminal layouts; existing R7 coverage retained.
validation.visual_review: Desktop conversation plus terminal, three columns in light, phone terminal and auxiliary window captures inspected.
validation.hosted: R7.1 published with existing owner-only access. HTTP 200; new terminal, project root, mixed split and real popup return verified on the live Site with no page errors. See evidence/terminal/hosted-smoke.json.

limits: This prototype still has one example project. Multi-project selection/isolation is not represented as validated.
No real shell or PTY. Commands are escaped and displayed as text; a few commands show explicitly labeled fixture output. No filesystem, process, provider or network command execution.
Real Electron terminal controller and process continuity remain product integration work.
